directAnswer: To troubleshoot a passkey, ensure that your device's software is up to date and that you are entering the correct passkey format. If issues persist, consider resetting your device's network settings.
summary: This guide provides steps to troubleshoot issues related to passkeys across different platforms, including common problems and solutions.

sections.heading: Common Issues with Passkeys
sections.body: Users often face issues such as incorrect passkey entry, device compatibility problems, and software version mismatches.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Troubleshooting Steps
sections.body: Follow the steps below based on your platform to resolve passkey issues.

sections.heading: Additional Tips
sections.body: If troubleshooting does not resolve the issue, consider reaching out to customer support for further assistance.

steps.title: Check Software Updates
steps.detail: For iOS, go to Settings > General > Software Update. For Android, navigate to Settings > System > System Update. Ensure your device is running the latest version.

steps.title: Verify Passkey Format
steps.detail: Ensure that the passkey is entered correctly, including any special characters or capitalization.

steps.title: Reset Network Settings
steps.detail: On iOS, go to Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings. On Android, go to Settings > System > Reset options > Reset Wi-Fi, mobile & Bluetooth.

steps.title: Test on Another Device
steps.detail: Try using the passkey on a different device to determine if the issue is device-specific.

faqs.question: What should I do if I forgot my passkey?
faqs.answer: If you forgot your passkey, you may need to reset it through the service or application that requires it.

faqs.question: Can a passkey be shared between devices?
faqs.answer: Passkeys are typically device-specific for security reasons; sharing may not be possible or secure.

faqs.question: What if my device is not compatible with the passkey?
faqs.answer: Check the system requirements for the application or service using the passkey; you may need to update your device or use a different one.

caveats: Some steps may vary slightly depending on the device model or software version.
Resetting network settings will remove saved Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth connections.
